svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 07 / SPACE INVADERS
svg.desc: 26,106 GitHub contributions across 172 active days, 2025-11-16 to 2026-11-18. The ship fires at real contribution dates in ascending count order. Invaders disappear only on projectile impact. A streak of seven consecutive active dates unlocks a boss.
